profile.headline: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer at Aledade
profile.summary:
I believe AI is going to transform nearly every industry, and I want to be part of making that happen.

I'm a software engineer who enjoys solving hard problems, building useful things, and turning emerging technologies into practical solutions. My background spans cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and AI-powered applications. I've worked on everything from large-scale enterprise systems to early-stage products, and I'm especially interested in the intersection of AI, engineering, and real-world impact. 

Currently, I'm a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer at Aledade, exploring how AI can improve workflows and make a difference in healthcare. Outside of work, I enjoy bringing people together around emerging technology through AI meetups, hackathons, and community events.

positions.title: Backend Developer
positions.description:
Ecommerce platform for used auto parts with a focus on functionality and user interface/experience (UI/UX)
● Served as lead back-end developer to design and implement a system to serve up user part data
● Utilized Amazon S3’s PHP SDK to store and retrieve user uploaded images.
● MySQL schema and query design, integrated with AWS EC2 deployment
● React/JSX for component creation and page routing with Axios for requesting server data

positions.title: Project Manager and HVAC Technician
positions.description:
● Promoted to manager from Service Tech
● Supervised Installation of HVAC software and hardware

positions.title: ASE Certified Mechanic
positions.description:
● Promoted to ASE Mechanic
● troubleshooted electrical and mechanical systems
